$comment: Single source of truth for the Input Group API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: input-group
title: Input Group
description: An input with text, icons or buttons attached.

start / end.description: Text, an icon or a small Button before or after the input.

examples.title: Text before and after
examples.description: Prefixes and suffixes such as a protocol or a currency. The whole group is drawn as an Input, so it matches every style.

examples.title: Icons
examples.description: An icon at the start, a shortcut hint at the end.

examples.title: With a button
examples.description: Put a small Button inside an addon for copy, submit or show-password actions.

a11y: The <input> has its own label; addons are visual and not part of its name.
If an addon carries meaning the label doesn't (a currency, a domain), say it in the label or hint too.
Buttons inside keep their own labels; icon-only buttons have an aria-label.
The focus ring wraps the whole group, so you always see where you are typing.
